SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002400
DOCKET NO. F00400225
PLAINTIFF – THE HAMPTON CLUB CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION INC
DEFENDANTS- EDGAR HOWARD, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday The 4th Day of November 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the CITY of NEW BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 1.06, C0526 BLOCK 596
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
526 EDPAS ROAD NEW BRUNSWICK, NJ 08901
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
The Property to be sold is located in the City of New Brunswick County of Middlesex and State of new Jersey
Commonly known as 526 Edpas Road, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901
TAX LOT 1.06, C0526: Block No 596
Dimension of Lot approximately
Nearest Cross Street
All that certain Lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the City of New Brunswick, County, County of Middlesex State of New Jersey
Unit 526 in Building 5, situated in The Hampton Club Condominiums, together _with an undivided 0.13785 percentage interest in the common elements of said Condominium (referred to in this Deed as the "Condominium Unit")' The conveyance evidenced by this deed is made under the provisions of and is subject to the New Jersey Condominium act (N.J.S.A. 46:8B-1, et. seq.) and the Planned Real Estate Development Act (N.J.S.A. 45:22A-21, ct. seq.) as amended, and any applicable regulations adopted under either law.
The conveyance evidenced by this deed is made in accordance with the terms, limitations, conditions, covenants, restrictions, easements, agreements and other provisions set forth in that certain Master Deed for The Hampton Club Condominiums, a Condominium, recorded in the Office of the Clerk/Register of Middlesex County on September 6, 1988 in Deed Book 3728 Page 1, as the same may now or hereafter be lawfully amended.
NOTE: Being Lot(s) 1.06 CO526, Block 596.03, Tax Map of the City of New Brunswick, County of Middlesex and being commonly known as 526 Edpas Road.
THE SHERTFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.
PRIOR LIENS/ENCUMBRANCES: Hudson City Savings Bank, Book 1180, page 355
Estimated Upset Amount: $6,533.16
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $6,988.16 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: September 23, 2026
MEZZACCA & KWASNIK LLC
980 AMBOY AVENUE SUITE 2
EDISON, NJ 08837
732-549-4600
